findings: Freedesktop is_parent uses realpath followed by startswith without a component boundary. /tmp/volume-other/a is considered under /tmp/volume; actual info_for emits Path=../volume-other/a despite its comment forbidding parent traversal. Reproduced using unchanged functions.

trash_move renames the source before opening and writing .trashinfo. A controlled metadata-open failure records rename first and no rollback. No actual file was moved. Destination-name allocation also uses check-then-rename without exclusive reservation; concurrency not exercised.

send2trash checks exists and writable source before lstat/device handling; dangling symlinks are rejected by exists. Home-trash device is inferred from the home directory rather than XDG_DATA_HOME, so a separately mounted XDG location can lead to cross-device rename failure. Source observations only.

Windows implementation checks SHFileOperationW result but does not inspect fAnyOperationsAborted after the call. Structure layout and native API compatibility remain unqualified; no Windows API executed.
macOS implementation uses FSRef/CoreServices functions; error comment pointer is decoded without checking for None. No native library import or trash operation executed.
Linux dispatcher attempts absent plat_gio then falls back to the bundled Freedesktop implementation. Vendor license is BSD three-clause, distinct from the root MIT license.

Default settings confirm terminal command lists containing $cwd on macOS, case-insensitive completion, confirmation before deletion, and saving newly created snippets disabled by default. Shared settings-object mutation still requires Sublime runtime verification.
